crossRefs.note: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.
Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
translations.bsb: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
translations.asv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
